quest.title: Good Hunter Express
quest.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm, I've got other things to do right now.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Really? Okay then. I'll find someone else to make that delivery...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Oh, yes, this Mondstadt Hash Brown is just out of the oven, so do handle it with care.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Don't <color=#00E1FFFF>run too fast, don't use your wind glider, and don't get into a fight</color>, or that hash brown may just come apart.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You do have to be quick, though. This dish won't taste good if it gets cold.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Hardworking Silio

dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: Ugh, I'm starving... Why hasn't my order arrived yet?

dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: Thanks for delivering this hash brown to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That's correct. You're here to help, right? Then you're right on time — I'd just finished making this Mondstadt Hash Brown.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: It's supposed to go to Silio. He paid us earlier, and said that he'd be waiting for his delivery near Stormbearer Point.

dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: Agh, I'm beat... I wonder when my food's going to arrive?
